issue_context.title: [networkd] please log obtained prefix
issue_context.body:
Hi,

after obtaining an IPv6 assignment from the DHCPv6 server, networkd logs the received address:

    Apr 19 15:17:59 prom systemd-networkd[34240]: unt381: DHCPv6 address 2001:16b8:30d4:fa00:840f:33ff:fe68:445f/128 timeout preferred 3600 valid 7200

This is nice.

If a prefix is delegated from the server (IA_PD), the received prefix should be logged as well.

Greetings
Marc

review_comments: Not too familiar with these functions - if this is in the hot/critical path, it might be worth to micro-optimize and return here if current log level < log_level, to avoid doing the formatting work just to have it thrown away. But only if this function is called in perf-critical path, otherwise it's fine as-is.
